rules: Use logical inline/block properties; never encode left/right as meaning.
DOM and focus order remain logical in RTL; visual reordering must not reverse semantics.
Content priority is preserved when columns collapse.
Tables expose a card/list alternative or bounded horizontal scroll with sticky row context.
Touch controls remain at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.

accessibility.conformance: WCAG 2.2 Level AA target; conformance is verified on implemented screens in later steps
requirements: Keyboard access for all interactive controls.
Logical focus order and focus not obscured.
Persian page language and RTL direction are programmatically set.
Status, validation and lifecycle meaning is not color-only.
Form errors have a summary and field-level association.
Async mutation and provider outcomes use appropriate live-region announcements.
Reduced-motion disables non-essential transitions and preserves understanding.
Zoom/reflow to 400 percent does not lose content or operation.
Text spacing overrides do not clip or overlap content.
Authentication does not depend on a cognitive-function test without an alternative.

layout.compact: Single column; full-width disclosure drawer; no fixed bottom action overlay.
layout.expanded: Inline-start sidebar, main flexible content; content max inherited.
layout.zoom: 400% at 1280 CSS-equivalent 320; same compact layout, no page horizontal scroll.
layout.tables: At compact widths equivalent labeled cards; no hidden essential fields or hover-only actions.

rules.requirement: create=draft; archive forces sales false; unarchive=draft and preserves stopped sales; archived update/publish/resume prohibited. Publish requires active variant and sellable price only when salesEnabled.

PATCH product/variant/brand/category and attribute/value updates require existing version. Product publish If-Match is optional in source; UI sends available version without claiming mandatory server enforcement. Other actions do not gain invented concurrency headers.
SKU required max120; optional barcode max120, suffix180, positive integer weight. Active status and salesEnabled differ; inactive resume prohibited.
Types text/number/boolean/select; exactly one typed value; assignments unique per attribute. PUT replaces the assignment set; no per-assignment optimistic-version guard is claimed.
Value belongs to attribute; product-vs-variant and primary category must match. Assignment replacement is transactional.
Only active media; variant must belong to product; MIME-derived type must match. At most one primary; reorder only attached media with nonnegative integer order. Detach removes relation only.
Brand/category name max150 and slug validation; category parent exists, self/descendant cycles prohibited. No delete/archive endpoint for brand/category invented.

JPEG/PNG/WebP/MP4; integer bytes 1..52428800; SHA256 required and calculated locally, not a manual user burden. Complete is separate from upload and approval; dimensions positive integers if supplied.

uploading -> processing via complete; processing/quarantine -> active via approve; uploading/processing/quarantine -> rejected; delete fails MEDIA_IN_USE while attached. No media list endpoint or restore endpoint exists in this C scope.

Configured target uses signed PUT expiring after15min; configuration absence fails closed. No automatic virus-scan, byte verification, thumbnail or actual storage availability claim from these sources. Upload URL and signing material remain hidden.

Scope global/brand/category/product/variant; non-global requires ID. Preview lasts10min; apply requires existing Step-Up. expected_affected_count compares stored preview count, not a fresh recount; no requester binding is proven by consumeSalesPreview. Do not claim either protection.

Admin products accepts limit/cursor only (default25,max100); no invented server q/status filters. Other lists may be unpaginated; UI may locally disclose/segment loaded records without pretending server pagination. No catalog audit-history HTTP endpoint. Product detail omits descriptions; edit does not invent prefill, and omits untouched absent fields.

review.limits: Representative static browser composition review; 400% reflow assessed via equivalent320 CSS-pixel design, not runtime keyboard/screen-reader/zoom certification.

screens.title: درخواست، بررسی و حذف رسانه

views.title: بارگذاری رسانه
items: JPEG، PNG، WebP یا MP4؛ حداکثر ۵۰ مگابایت
پس از ارسال فایل، تکمیل و بررسی جداگانه انجام می‌شود

views.title: رسانه در حال بررسی
items: ابعاد در صورت ثبت باید مثبت باشند
تکمیل بارگذاری به معنی تأیید رسانه نیست

views.title: تأیید یا رد رسانه
items: نام، نوع و وضعیت فعلی را بررسی کنید
فقط رسانهٔ پردازشی یا قرنطینه قابل تأیید است

views.title: رد رسانه
items: رد برای حالت بارگذاری، پردازش یا قرنطینه مجاز است
این تصمیم فایل فعال را خودکار حذف نمی‌کند

views.title: حذف رسانه
items: رسانهٔ متصل به کالا قابل حذف نیست
ابتدا اتصال‌ها را بررسی کنید؛ حذف برگشت خودکار ندارد

views.title: ارسال فایل در دسترس نیست
items: برای پیگیری با مسئول پشتیبانی تماس بگیرید

views.title: رسانه هنوز استفاده می‌شود

items: مهلت اعتبار پیش‌نمایش را بررسی کنید
